# gitmoap_group_ai_org_model_connections (Data Source)

List the organization's model connections. Each connection's provider, its state and condition, where it routes and whether only endpoints that keep nothing serve it, the key's label and last four characters, who consented and when, and when the consent lapses if its giver is no longer an Owner. Never a key.

The token needs `ai_org:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_ai_org_model_connections" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The organization's top-level group

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) One per connected provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `condition_until` (String) Until when a `limited` connection waits, or when a refused one is next tried.
- `connected_at` (String) When the current key was activated.
- `connection_id` (String) A model connection's id: an organization's own account with a model provider, which its agents' calls run on once connected.
- `consent_lapses_at` (String) When the connection stops being usable because the person who consented is no longer an
Owner; absent while they are one.
- `consented_at` (String) When they consented.
- `consented_by` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--consented_by))
- `key_hint` (String) The key's last four characters.
- `key_label` (String) The label the provider holds the key under, so an Owner can find it there.
- `org_id` (String)
- `provider` (String) A provider an organization may connect an account of its own with.
- `routing_region` (String) Where the provider routes a connection's calls; part of the consent.
- `state` (String) Whether the provider accepts a connection's calls.
- `unservable_models` (List of String) Catalogue models the routing could not serve, held back until they are tried again.
- `zero_data_retention` (Boolean) Whether only endpoints that keep nothing may serve the organization's calls.

<a id="nestedatt--items--consented_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.consented_by`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The principal's picture, when one is known. Absent otherwise: a client derives the
deterministic avatar URL itself.
- `email` (String) The principal's address. An agent's is a generated no-reply address — the author of its
commits. `unknown` on a deleted actor and empty on a redacted one.
- `id` (String) The principal's id: a user id, a service account id or an agent id, as `kind` says. Empty on
a redacted actor.
- `kind` (String) A person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — which of the three a principal is,
and so which page it links to: a person's profile, a service account's page or an agent's page.
- `username` (String) The name to show: a person's or service account's username, or an agent's handle (which
always ends in `-ai`). `deleted-user` when the actor no longer resolves, `redacted` when the
caller may not see who it was. A closed account whose work stays is `closed-` and twelve hex
digits, a shape no open account may take, with an address under `.invalid`.
